note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is unknown and only the soldier is described; one postmentum constriction index is omitted because of OCR damage; nomenclatural and type-material records, distribution and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow, fontanelle region cream yellow; antennae straw yellow; labrum, pronotum, legs and abdomen yellowish white; mandibles brown, right mandible paler than left. Head with moderate pilosity, denser on the frontal prominence. Head capsule subrectangular (1.37 mm long to base of mandibles, 0.96 mm maximum width); sides nearly parallel, slightly narrowed anteriorly; frontal prominence distinct, blunt and rounded. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 2 and segment 3 subequal in length; segment 4 shortest. Lateral margins of labrum produced into short spine-like projections; anterior margin slightly incurved. Mandibles asymmetrical; left mandible pointed and hook-shaped; right mandible blade-like, sharply pointed at the tip (left mandible 1.38 mm long, right mandible 1.30 mm long). Postmentum rod-like (0.64 mm long, 0.26 mm maximum width, 0.21 mm width at waist); waist very weakly constricted, situated near posterior margin. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin weakly notched at middle (0.23 mm long, 0.55 mm maximum width).
